Even though the Lambda function includes content in the response to support CORS, you still
might see the following error:
Access to XMLHttpRequest at '<api-gateway-endpoint>' from origin 'null' has been
blocked by CORS policy: No 'Access-Control-Allow-Origin' header is present in the
requested resource.
If this happens, try the following:
1.
Enable CORS on the GET resource. Under Advanced, set Access-Control-Allow-Credentials to
'true'.
2.
Redeploy your API in API Gateway (Actions, Deploy API).
3.
Delete and re-add your Lambda function trigger. Add re-add it, choose Add trigger and
create the HTTP endpoint that invokes your function. The trigger must have the following
conﬁguration:
Trigger
API
Deployment Stage
Security

opensearch-api
opensearch-api-test
